title: cot-prompt template variables
description: Values for templates/cot-prompt.md.j2 and templates/cot-prompt.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from cot-prompt.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

input.title: Input
input.description: What is the concrete input for this run? The eval runner substitutes one case per invocation; fill it by hand only when rendering the prompt for a single case.

task.title: Task
task.description: What is the model being asked to do? State the task once, in the imperative, with the success condition in it - the reasoning block is only as good as this sentence.
